_comment: Source locations GTNH's own index (DreamAssemblerXXL gtnh-assets.json) lacks or gets wrong, found by hand.
Keyed by the mod name in the release manifest. gtnh_ref.py `index` merges these into MOD-INDEX.md.
repo + ref: a GitHub repo and the tag or branch to read. exact: true only if ref was verified to be the pack's version.
scope: 'full' (the whole mod, default), 'api' (only its API), or 'decompiled' (third-party decompiled source: hedge applies).
extras: other evidence. kind is dev-jar (deobfuscated classes, MCP names), api-source (official .java), decompiled-source, or maven (a coordinate for dependencies.gradle).
Verified against GTNH 2.9.0-RC-2 on 2026-10-17. Re-check entries whose version changes when the pack updates.

Industrial Craft 2.note: No public source for IC2 itself. The -api jar is the official ic2.api source (91 .java files). For internals, decompile the -dev jar (already MCP-named).

Thaumcraft.note: Azanor's official API source (branch last updated 2015-12). Thaumcraft's own code was never published; the -sources jar below is Fernflower output, not original source.

extras.note: as used by GT5-Unofficial; resolves from gregtech.overminddl1.com

JourneyMap.note: The pack ships the 5.2.23 'fairplay' build of this tag.

Tinkers-Gregworks.note: No tags; the GT-NH branch is what GTNH builds from.

Biomes O' Plenty.note: The 1.7.10 branch (last commit 2017-11); build 2308 is believed to be its final state. Confirm with javap.

extras.note: obfuscated; wrap in rfg.deobf(...), as GT5-Unofficial does

Hunger-Overhaul.note: The author's source (last push 2016-08); not pinned to jenkins build 104. GTNH-Museum/HungerOverhaul is a later rewrite, not this jar.

Witchery.note: 'Source is for reference only': decompiled by a third party, version unverified. Code relying on it needs a Decompiled: hedge.

extras.note: obfuscated; wrap in rfg.deobf(...), as GT5-Unofficial does

Ztones.note: No source found. GTNewHorizons/Ztones-Unofficial is a from-scratch rewrite (2.3.x), not the 2.2.2 jar in the pack.

Advanced Solar Panel For 1.7.10 (Unoffic.note: No source or dev jar found.

Gravitation-Suite-old.note: No source found; GitHub repos named GraviSuite are later reconstructions, not this jar.
